Khushi however, dresses up Lavanya like a bride to impress Arnav. Shashi on the other hand, enquires about Shyam's background.

videos.title: Lavanya Leaves the Raizada House
videos.overview: Arnav scolds Lavanya and Khushi, and makes it clear that he does not want to get married. Lavanya leaves the house and Arnav asks Khushi to quit her job. She tries to defend Lavanya and explain her view to Arnav. Will Arnav listen?

videos.title: Khushi Tries to Resolve the Fight
videos.overview: Shyam avoids confrontation with Khushi. Lavanya tells Khushi about returning to London forever. Meanwhile, Anjali and Shyam try to change Arnav's view on marriage. Later, he scolds Khushi for disturbing him and tells her about his changed feelings for Lavanya. Shashi finally gets hold of Anjali's number.

videos.title: Lavanya Comes to Raizada House
videos.overview: Lavanya comes back to Raizada house with Arnav. Anjali welcomes them, but Nani still disapproves of Lavanya. Later, Anjali asks Akash about his feelings for Payal. Meanwhile, Lavanya fails to impress Nani again.

videos.title: Khushi Saves Lavanya
videos.overview: Nani is furious over shifting of the Tulsi plant, but Khushi puts the blame on Arnav to save Lavanya from Nani's anger. Meanwhile, Manorama explains the significance of Ashtami pooja to Lavanya and Nani gives her the responsibilities of the gifts. Later, Shyam hints Madhumati for Khushi and his marriage.

videos.title: The Temple Visit
videos.overview: Shyam bribes the priest before Anjali and her parents arrive. Anjali spots him near the temple, but he manages to escape again. Later, Arnav finds his project model broken and blames Khushi for it. How will Khushi react?

videos.title: Arnav Gets Dizzy
videos.overview: Arnav is angry on seeing the kids. Anjali informs him that she has invited them for pooja. Arnav calls Khushi, who is nervous about talking to him. While Shyam doubts Shashi, Lavanya tells Khushi that Arnav is going to Nainital. Meanwhile, Arnav feels dizzy while watering the plants.

videos.title: Khushi Apologises to Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi tends to Arnav when she finds him. Payal invites Aakash to have tea with her parents. Meanwhile, Arnav laughs when Khushi apologises to him for being rude. Later, Lavanya tells Manorama about the allergy on her face.

videos.title: Arnav Finds Khushi
videos.overview: Madhumati asks Shyam for his horoscope. While Arnav finds Khushi in the trunk of his car, Nani scolds Lavanya for trying to use holy water to wash her face. Meanwhile, Arnav's vehicle breaks down on the way to Nainital. He is annoyed when Khushi keeps talking throughout the way.

videos.title: Khushi Has a Fall
videos.overview: Shashi shows Shyam his driving licence and asks about the confusion over his date of birth. Khushi falls into a pit and Arnav finds her. Meanwhile, Manorama is shocked when she sees Akash lifting Payal. Later, Khushi's clothes are stolen and she gets stuck in the washroom.

videos.title: Payal Rejects Akash's Calls
videos.overview: Arnav and Khushi stop at a dhaba. Shashi informs the family that Khushi has gone to Nainital with Arnav. Akash calls up Payal to apologise but she rejects his call. Meanwhile, Arnav is irritated with Khushi and leaves her at the dhaba.

videos.title: Shashi Exposes Shyam
videos.overview: While Shashi exposes Shyam, Khushi convinces Arnav not to leave her. Arnav asks her to leave before the next morning. But he later realises that she has fever. Meanwhile, Manorama talks to Anjali about Akash's interest in Payal. Later, Shashi follows Shyam and finds Anjali with him.

videos.title: Arnav Hurts Khushi
videos.overview: While Arnav regrets his behaviour towards Khushi, Shashi threatens to expose Shyam in front of his family. When Shashi gets hysterical, Shyam stops him from taking his medicine. Meanwhile, some miscreants stop Khushi and Arnav. Arnav attacks them, but accidentally hurts Khushi.

videos.title: Shyam Attempts Murder
videos.overview: The doctor tells Shyam that Shashi's condition is critical. Payal informs Anjali about Shashi's condition. On reaching Delhi, Arnav gives Khushi some money and asks her to leave. While Akash is upset as Payal refuses to talk to him, Shyam disrupts Shashi's oxygen supply. Will he survive?

videos.title: Shashi Is Paralyzed
videos.overview: Anjali tells Arnav about Shashi's health condition. Shyam torments Shashi as he knows that he can't react. Khushi is sad and upset on seeing Shyam's condition. Meanwhile, Anjali tries to console Khushi's family.

videos.title: Shyam Wants to Marry Khushi
videos.overview: An emotional Khushi sees Arnav and begins to cry. Shyam tricks Madhumati and Garima into believing that Shashi wants him to marry Khushi. He tells them that he is willing to marry Khushi, but will never leave Anjali as he wants to be with both of them.

videos.title: Khushi's Reluctance
videos.overview: Khushi learns that Arnav has cleared Shashi's hospital bills. Akash apologises to Payal on behalf of Manorama. Later, Madhumati talks to Khushi about her marriage with Shyam.  However, Khushi isn't willing to marry him.

videos.title: Akash Tells Anjali About Payal
videos.overview: Payal consoles Khushi as she worries about her marriage with Shyam. Akash tells Anjali about his feelings for Payal. Later, Khushi is upset as she fails to buy any silver or gold on Dhanteras. However, Arnav surprises her. How does he make Khushi happy?

videos.title: Khushi Refuses to Get Engaged
videos.overview: Arnav helps Khushi untangle herself from the light wires. Meanwhile, Madhumati and Garima confirm Khushi’s engagement with Shyam. Later, while giving medicines to Shashi, Khushi tells him that she won’t marry Shyam. But Shyam overhears her conversation.

videos.title: Akash Buys a Diya for Payal
videos.overview: Khushi explains the significance of Diwali to Lavanya. She later seeks Arnav’s help to decorate the hall. Meanwhile, Akash gets a ‘diya’ for Payal. Later, Arnav and Khushi fall on the rangoli. Does Payal accept Akash’s gift?

videos.title: Khushi Is in Love With Arnav
videos.overview: Arnav is mesmerised when he sees Khushi in a saree. Khushi realises that she is in love with Arnav. She imagines herself and Arnav as a couple. Shyam tries to cheer her up by getting sweets and decorating the house. What makes Khushi realise her love for Arnav?

videos.title: Khushi Rejects Shyam's Proposal
videos.overview: Anjali asks Arnav why he is worried. Khushi makes Nani happy by telling her about her plans to make diyas. While Lavanya asks her to steal mud from Arnav's plants for the diyas, Madhumati is angry on learning that Khushi has rejected Shyam's proposal. What will Madhumati do now?

videos.title: Arnav Finds Khushi's Video
videos.overview: Khushi steals mud from Arnav’s plants. Instead of getting angry, he allows her to take it and even removes mud from her eyes. Khushi thinks Arnav is practising black magic. Later, Arnav is shocked to see Khushi's video on his laptop. What is the video about?

videos.title: Khushi Punishes Herself
videos.overview: Khushi apologises to Arnav for trying to spoil his throat and consumes the juice herself. Later, she receives Diwali gifts from Anjali. Meanwhile, Madhumati is emotional thinking about Shashi and requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi change her mind?

videos.title: Arnav Is Mesmerized
videos.overview: Khushi’s family performs Diwali pooja with the Raizada family. Meanwhile, Shyam deliberately falls sick to avoid meeting Khushi. She and Nani are delighted to see Lavanya shout at her friends for making fun of Nani. Will Khushi learn about Shyam’s presence in the house?

videos.title: Nani Has a Wish
videos.overview: Nani praises Lavanya and tells her that she wishes her to marry Arnav. Khushi is unhappy when she hears this. Later, Khushi sprains her ankle and goes to Anjali’s room. Will she see Shyam in the room?

videos.title: Khushi Wants Answers From Arnav
videos.overview: Arnav and Khushi are lost in a moment of love. Khushi is curious to know how Arnav has her anklet. She tries to get him to answer all her questions, but fails to do so. Later, Arnav shocks her when he agrees to marry Lavanya in front of the guests. What is the reason behind his decision?

videos.title: Khushi Congratulates Arnav
videos.overview: Everyone congratulates Arnav. He, however, stops Nani from fixing the marriage date. Later, while dropping Khushi, he brings up the topic of the anklet. Khushi tells him that he and Lavanya make a good pair. Arnav then asks her to step out of the car. Why does Arnav stop Nani from finalising the wedding date?

videos.title: Madhumati's Request to Khushi
videos.overview: Madhumati welcomes Arnav to her house. Arnav tells Khushi that she doesn’t mean anything to him. Later, Madhumati screams on seeing Khushi and Shyam’s names written on the wall. She requests Khushi to marry Shyam. Will Khushi agree?

videos.title: Arnav Thinks About Khushi
videos.overview: Madhumati and Garima are happy with Khushi’s decision to marry Shyam. Arnav recalls his past with Khushi and gets disturbed. What is the motive behind Shyam’s decision to marry Khushi?

videos.title: Khushi Gets Farewell Gifts
videos.overview: Khushi visits the Raizada house on Anjali and Nani’s request. She overhears Arnav getting angry with Anjali for inviting her. Later, Nani, Anjali and Lavanya give farewell gifts to Khushi. But Arnav then asks her to leave the house. Why is Arnav hostile towards Khushi?

videos.title: Shashi Gets  the Wrong Medicine
videos.overview: Arnav feels guilty for being rude to Khushi. Shyam is angry for the delay in his engagement with Khushi. In a fit of rage, he puts Shashi’s life in danger, giving him the wrong medicine. Why doesn’t Shyam and Khushi’s engagement take place?

videos.title: Khushi Is Unhappy
videos.overview: Madhumati blames Khushi for Shashi’s condition and asks her to get engaged to Shyam immediately. Left with no choice, Khushi gets engaged to Shyam. He gives her a gift to cheer her up. Later, Anjali asks Shyam about his wedding ring. Will Anjali find out the truth?

videos.title: Anjali  Celebrates Bhaiduj
videos.overview: While celebrating Bhaiduj, Anjali shouts at Arnav for being rude to Khushi. While, Payal apologises to Akash for her behaviour, Lavanya and Nani hatch a plan to make Khushi stay back at the Raizada house. Will Khushi stay back despite Arnav’s rudeness?

videos.title: Arnav Feels Guilty
videos.overview: Arnav sees Khushi in the house and insults her for returning to the Raizada house. He and Khushi decide not to talk to each other. Meanwhile, Anjali informs Shyam about inviting Khushi for Arnav’s engagement. How will Shyam react to Khushi’s return to the Raizada house?

videos.title: Manorama Asks Khushi to Leave
videos.overview: Shyam jokes with Anjali about getting remarried. Later, Lavanya informs everyone that Arnav will not go to the office for some days. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to convey a message to Arnav, but fails to do so. Later, Manorama asks her to leave the house as Lavanya has learnt all the household chores.

videos.title: Arnav Receives Khushi's Note
videos.overview: Nani and Lavanya continue their fake fight to make Khushi stay. Manorama asks Khushi to meet her near the temple. Meanwhile, Arnav finds an old note written by Khushi. He saves her from falling into the pool. Later, Khushi deliberately disturbs him while he is on an important call and runs away.

videos.title: Akash Proposes to Payal
videos.overview: Arnav does not talk to Khushi. Shyam tries to fix the marriage dates. Meanwhile, Akash surprises Payal by sending her a gift which she had desired, and proposes to her. Later, Khushi finds Arnav talking to the stars.

videos.title: Akash Proposes to Payal
videos.overview: While Akash proposes to Payal, Arnav finds Khushi’s ring at the poolside, but fails to recognise it. Madhumati is shocked on learning about the ring and asks Khushi to look for it. Will Payal accept Akash’s proposal?

videos.title: Arnav Learns About the Engagement
videos.overview: Khushi learns about Nani and Lavanya’s fake fight. She later informs Shyam about losing the engagement ring. Arnav asks Khushi to apologise if she wants her ring back. She obliges and also tells him about her engagement. How will Arnav react?

videos.title: Arnav Makes Comparisons
videos.overview: Arnav is annoyed that Khushi kept her engagement a secret. He tries to physically hurt himself while talking to her. Lavanya asks Khushi to dress the wound. Arnav reluctantly congratulates Khushi and at the same time, insults her by comparing himself to her fiancé.

videos.title: Arnav Talks About Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav tells Anjali that he suspects Khushi was forced to get engaged. He then informs everyone about his decision to advance his engagement with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Khushi grows suspicious about the voice she heard on Anjali’s phone. Is Arnav trying to play mind games with Khushi?

videos.title: Khushi's Suspicion About Shyam
videos.overview: Lavanya is worried by her parents' absence at her engagement. Khushi is disinterested in Arnav's engagement and tells him that. Later, she asks Shyam about Arnav and Lavanya’s engagement. She grows suspicious of Shyam’s character.

videos.title: Arnav Gifts a Necklace to Lavanya
videos.overview: Payal lies to Khushi about her love for Akash. She is later shocked to see Akash at home. Meanwhile, Anjali and Lavanya are busy buying jewellery for the engagement. Later, Arnav tries to humiliate Khushi by gifting her favourite necklace to Lavanya.

videos.title: Anjali Gets Suspicious of Shyam
videos.overview: Anjali is shocked to learn about Shyam’s lie regarding the ring. Naani is curious on seeing her worried. While Lavanya forces Khushi to wear a wedding dress, Arnav humiliates Khushi again. What has Anjali learnt about Shyam?

videos.title: Arnav Gets Angry With Lavanya
videos.overview: Lavanya buys the dresses suggested by Khushi. Arnav scolds her for wearing a cheap dress. While Khushi tries to defend Lavanya, Manorama wants Akash to get engaged soon. Later, Akash asks Payal to meet him for the last time. Will he convince her to accept his proposal?

videos.title: Akash and Payal Are Seen Together
videos.overview: While Shyam evades Anjali’s questions, Akash is excited about meeting Payal. Coincidentally, Arnav and Khushi also happen to meet each other in the same restaurant. They argue and then see Akash and Payal together.

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi Decide to Meet
videos.overview: Khushi and Arnav are shocked when they see Akash propose to Payal. Later at home, Arnav is surprised to see Akash in a sad mood. Khushi also sees Payal in a similar condition. Khushi then decides to meet Arnav in the same restaurant. Why does she want to meet him?

videos.title: Arnav - Khushi Hatch a Plan
videos.overview: Khushi and Arnav draw up a plan to reunite Akash and Payal. Although Payal finds out about their plan, Arnav assures Khushi of convincing Payal and Akash’s parents about their marriage. Will he keep his promise?

videos.title: Manorama Refuses to Accept Payal
videos.overview: Khushi assures Payal that Arnav will convince his parents. Everyone but Manorama agrees to the marriage. Khushi and Arnav then plan to have a second go at convincing Manorama again. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Manorama Accepts Payal
videos.overview: In order to stress her disapproval, Manorama pretends to leave the house. Arnav, however, convinces her to stay. Manorama agrees to the marriage, but with a condition. Everyone is happy as Akash thanks her for accepting Payal. But what is Manorama’s condition?

videos.title: Both the Families Are Ready for Akash and Payal's Marriage
videos.overview: Khushi informs Payal about the Raizada family's decision. Madhumati is amazed to see Raizada family arrive at their home. Shyam tries to hide away from the Raizada family. Both the families are gratified and are ready for Akash and Payal's marriage. Shashi is being introduced to the Raizada family. He starts to panic seeing Anjali’s face and tries to tell everyone about Shyam.

videos.title: Khushi Punctures Arnav's Tyre
videos.overview: While Shashi tries to tell to Anjali the truth about Shyam, the Raizadas wish to meet Khushi’s fiancé. Later, Payal thanks Arnav for helping her and Akash. Later, Arnav yells at Khushi for being unsure about her decisions. But Khushi retaliates and punctures his car tyre.

videos.title: Khushi Gets Suspicious of Shyam
videos.overview: Shashi’s feeble attempts to expose Shyam raise Khushi’s suspicions about the latter. Later, she overhears Shyam asking Akash about her being invited for the Satyanarayan puja. During the puja, she tries to recognise his face as he is sitting ahead of her. Will she manage to expose him?

videos.title: The Truth About Shyam
videos.overview: Anjali is worried as Shyam is absent from the puja. Khushi leaves the puja to call him. Her doubts are cleared as the situation reminds her of a similar incident from the past. Disheartened, she breaks down in front of Arnav. Will she tell him the truth about Shyam?

videos.title: Khushi Warns Shyam
videos.overview: Unaware of the truth, Anjali introduces Shyam to Khushi. Khushi is reminded of Shyam’s tricks in the past to fool her family. Later, on seeing Shyam, she warns him to stay away from her and her family. Shyam then apologises to her for his fraudulent ways. Will Shyam really mend his ways?

videos.title: Shyam Threatens Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi is uncertain about how to deal with Shyam. Madhumati curses Shyam for playing with her emotions. Later, when Khushi decides to expose him, Shyam threatens to ruin Akash and Payal’s relationship.

videos.title: Arnav Breaks Up With Lavanya
videos.overview: On meeting Anjali, Khushi changes her mind about exposing Shyam. Arnav tells Lavanya that he has no feelings for her and decides to inform his family as well. How does Lavanya react to Arnav’s revelation about their relationship?

videos.title: Khushi Refuses to Expose Shyam
videos.overview: As Madhumati and Payal eagerly await the Raizada family’s decision about Shyam, Khushi informs them that she has not revealed the truth to the Raizadas. Payal then decides to forget about the past and focus on her engagement with Akash.

videos.title: Arnav and Lavanya Are Blessed
videos.overview: Arnav is sorry for breaking Lavanya's heart. Khushi threatens to expose Shyam before Anjali. Later, Nani introduces Shyam to Khushi's family. Madhumati rebukes Manorama. Meanwhile, Khushi wishes Arnav luck and congratulates Payal and Lavanya.

videos.title: Arnav Declares His Break Up
videos.overview: Lavanya informs Khushi about her break-up and requests her to keep it a secret until Payal and Akash’s engagement. Meanwhile, Payal and Akash get engaged in a grand function. Arnav then informs everyone about his break-up with Lavanya.

videos.title: Lavanya Defends Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi yells at Arnav for breaking up with Lavanya. She then tries to stop Lavanya from leaving the house. Nani asks Arnav to give a solid reason behind his decision and refuses to let Lavanya go. But Lavanya tells everyone that it was a mutual decision and bids them goodbye.

videos.title: Anjali Supports Arnav's Break-Up
videos.overview: Khushi decides never to speak about Shyam. At the Raizada house, Arnav gets full support from Anjali for his decision to break up with Lavanya. Later, Khushi is seen imitating Akash in the bathroom. Mistaking Arnav to be Payal, she pulls him inside the bathroom.

videos.title: Manorama Welcomes Nanda Kishore
videos.overview: Khushi helps Anjali with the wedding arrangements. She notices Anjali ordering Shyam to change his white shirt. Shyam tells her that Anjali is ill-treating him. Meanwhile, Manorama is all excited to welcome their special guest from Sydney, Nanda Kishore.

videos.title: Arnav Plans a Cocktail Party
videos.overview: Shyam requests Anjali to manage his daily expenses account. Meanwhile, Arnav announces a cocktail party for Akash and Payal. Khushi and Nanda Kishore wish to have desi entertainment at the party. Will Khushi learn about Shyam’s motives?

videos.title: No Desi Entertainment
videos.overview: Khushi is angry with Arnav for refusing to arrange desi entertainment for the cocktail party. Akash gives a letter for Payal to Khushi. Later, he arrives at their house to escort them for the party. Khushi doesn’t go to the party due to a sprained ankle. Later, she asks Nanda Kishore for a favour.

videos.title: Khushi Dances With Nanda Kishore
videos.overview: Arnav is angry on learning that Khushi is Nanda Kishore’s date at the cocktail party. The guests are bored and Khushi taunts Arnav about it. Later, to infuse some life into the party, Khushi and Nanda Kishore perform a dance for the guests on a desi song.

videos.title: Arnav Won't Dance With Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav offers to drop Khushi home, but she goes with Nanda Kishore. Both families prepare for the Sangeet ceremony. At the Sangeet rehearsal, Anjali introduces Khushi and Payal to the choreographer hired for the ceremony. The choreographer pairs Khushi with Arnav, but Arnav refuses to dance with her.

videos.title: Shyam Tries to Brainwash Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi and Nanda Kishore have a hard time syncing their steps. Shyam also joins the dance rehearsal and tries poisoning Khushi’s mind against Anjali. Madhumati pulls out her wedding dress for Khushi. Later, Khushi irritates Arnav by using Nanda Kishore as her weapon.

videos.title: Nanda Kishore's Belief
videos.overview: The choreographer Madhubala once again asks Arnav and Khushi to dance together, but they refuse. She then asks the elders from the both the families to dance, too. Meanwhile, Shyam is plans to earn Khushi’s trust. Nanda Kishore shares his belief about meeting your lover on New Year’s night.

videos.title: Arnav Hears Khushi Chat
videos.overview: Madhumati asks Khushi to wear her old wedding dress on the wedding day. She and Garima then discuss what to gift the groom’s family. Anjali refuses dance as she is unwell and informs Shyam. Later, Arnav finds Nanda Kishore chatting with Khushi over the phone.

videos.title: Khushi Vows Not to Look at Arnav
videos.overview: Nanda Kishore comes up with a plan for Akash and Payal to meet at midnight on New Year’s. Akash asks Arnav to accompany him, but in vain. Khushi vows to not see Arnav’s face at midnight because of Nanda Kishore’s romantic belief.

videos.title: Akash Hides From Madhumati
videos.overview: After failing to bring Payal out of the house, Akash sneaks into the house to see her at midnight. In order to hide from Madhumati, he hides under the table. Meanwhile, Shyam plans to kill Anjali by electrocuting her. He brings her to the edge of the pool to push her into the water.

videos.title: Manorama's Husband Saves Anjali.
videos.overview: Manorama's husband saves Anjali before Shyam could push her into the pool. Payal tries to hide Akash from Madhumati while he is stuck to a chair. Arnav goes to Madhumati's house to help Akash get out of the sticky situation. Nanda Kishore plans to sneak out of the Raizada house to see Khushi at midnight. Akash persuades Payal to come out with him to celebrate New Year.  Arnav goes back to Madhumati's house to look for his mobile phone. As clock hits 12 Khushi switches on the light and sees Arnav on New Year's night.

videos.title: Arnav Hides in Khushi's Room
videos.overview: Khushi yells at Arnav for ruining her New Year’s Eve. Arnav asks her to keep quiet lest she wake up the entire family. Nanda Kishore knocks on Khushi’s door to greet her, but Madhumati opens the door. In order to hide from Madhumati, Arnav lies down on Khushi’s bed pretending to be Payal.

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi's Accusations
videos.overview: Arnav and Khushi blame each other for the unplanned meeting. Later, Arnav and Akash confront Nanda Kishore for sneaking into Khushi’s house at midnight. While Anjali looks at Shyam’s face at midnight, Shyam stares at Khushi’s picture.

videos.title: Cancelling of the Sangeet
videos.overview: Khushi vows to defeat the Raizadas at the Sangeet. She notices a mosquito sitting on Arnav's face when he is talking to Nand Kishore about the sangeeth and slaps him to kill the mosquito. Arnav gets angry and cancels the dance competition. Khushi tries to explain. Will Arnav change his mind?

videos.title: Arnav Gives His Nod
videos.overview: Arnav informs Khushi that he cancelled the Sangeet because he doesn't like the loud noise. In return, Khushi and the entire family start talking in sign language. Arnav, then, assumes that Anjali skips her lunch because she is sad about the Sangeeth being cancelled. He goes to her room and sees her having her lunch. How will he react?

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: Nani declares that the winner will get a forty-year-old Natraj idol as the award. Khushi and Arnav vow to defeat each other. While practicing for the competition, Madhumati catches Shyam secretly looking at Khushi. She confronts him. Arnav gets angry on seeing Nand Kishore calling up Khushi to chat with her. Will Shyam mend his ways?

videos.title: Khushi Impersonates Manorama and Madhumati
videos.overview: Manorama claims that Payal had not only stolen Akash from her but also her position as the daughter-in-law of the Raizada family. Akash reassures her that he will always be her son. Payal is worried that Manorama will ill treat her after marriage. Khushi impersonates Manorama and Madhumati to cheer up Payal. Raizada family goes to Payal's house. Arnav is amused to see Khushi dressed like Manorama. Arnav and Khushi argue about who will win the dance competition.

videos.title: Shyam and the Scorpion
videos.overview: Manorama insults Madhumati for gifting a silver puja plate to Anjali. Akash, however, praises Madhumati for the same. Payal gets worried about Manorama’s dislike towards her, but Khushi reassures her.  Shyam hides a poisonous scorpion in a sweet box in a move to kill Anjali. Will the scorpion sting Anjali?

videos.title: Shyam's Search
videos.overview: Shyam frantically searches for the sweet box.  Madhumati and Khushi bring stage props to the Raizada house.  Anjali and Shyam host the Sangeet and declare the dance competition open. Nani’s performance intimidates Madhumati. Does Shyam find the sweet box?

videos.title: Manorama Cheats in the Dance Competition
videos.overview: Shyam finds the sweet box that contains the poisonous scorpion in the kitchen. To defeat Madhumati in the dance competition, Manorama mixes liquor in the juice. After consuming the doctored juice, Madhumati gets dizzy and forgets the dance steps on the stage. Khushi is distressed when Manorama scores high points and puts the Raizada family in the lead. Arnav is pleased to see the Gupta family lagging behind.

videos.title: Khushi Pokes  Arnav
videos.overview: Nand Kishore boosts Khushi’s confidence, but Arnav taunts her for being nervous.  Manorama insults Payal in front of all the guests.  Khushi gives a great performance and is praised by all. She makes fun of Arnav on the stage. How does Arnav react?

videos.title: Shyam's Threat to Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav taunts Khushi. Shyam threatens Khushi for rejecting his love. Arnav thinks Khushi is crying to gain his sympathy. Madhumati confronts Manorama for lacing her drink with alcohol.  Khushi’s dance partner ditches her and she doesn't have a partner. What will Khushi do?

videos.title: Arnav Dances With Khushi
videos.overview: The Raizadas and the Guptas are stunned to see Arnav volunteering to dance with Khushi. The couple's performance leaves everyone speechless.  Manorama and Shyam do not like Arnav and Khushi’s closeness. Shyam yells at Nand Kishore for praising Khushi and Arnav’s pair. Will the dance performance bring Arnav and Khushi closer?

videos.title: Khushi Wins
videos.overview: Khushi thanks Arnav for dancing with her and gets flustered when he compliments her. Khushi receives the gold Nataraj idol for best performance. Shyam is displeased to see Arnav and Khushi together. He puts the scorpion on Anjali's bed in a bid to kill her. Will Anjali see the scorpion?

videos.title: Arnav Tries to Protect Anjali
videos.overview: Arnav becomes overprotective about Anjali after the scorpion incident. He asks her to conduct the Mehendi rasam at Raizada house.  Akash sneaks into the room where the rasam is happening to get a glimpse of Payal. Nand Kishore also participates in the function in disguise. Does Nand Kishore get caught?

videos.title: Khushi Is Branded
videos.overview: Nand Kishore blames Arnav for getting caught. Anjali arranges for an exclusive mehendi designer for Payal.  Manorama demands to get her mehendi done first. Arnav’s name gets written on Khushi’s hand by mistake.  Nani gives a grand red saree and the family bridal necklace to Payal. Manorama gets disheartened on seeing it.

videos.title: Khushi Gets a Kiss Challenge From Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi and Anjali berate Arnav for disappearing all of a sudden. Payal serves tea to Manorama in her room. Manorama warns her to be ready for a life of servitude to her after marriage. Khushi tries to get rid off the alphabet 'A' written on her hand. Arnav listens to Khushi's apologetic message in his voice mail. He sees the 'A' written on her hand and questions her. Khushi drops Payal's bangle in the pool and tries retrieving it. Arnav kisses Khushi and challenges her to kiss him back.

videos.title: Anjali's Perfume Mixing
videos.overview: Anjali sees the letter 'A' on Khushi’s hand and plots with Nani to bring Arnav and Khushi close.  Madhumati sends Khushi to the Raizada house to deliver Akash’s suit.  Khushi flirts with Nand Kishore to make Arnav jealous. Shyam sets another death trap for Anjali. What is Shyam’s latest move against Anjali?

videos.title: Arnav Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Nani and Anjali are happy to see Arnav and Khushi having feelings for each other. They act as though they are matchmaking for Khushi and Nand Kishore, to make Arnav jealous.  Shashi blesses Payal with his paralysed hand and surprises everyone.  Shyam makes another attempt to kill Anjali. What does he do?

videos.title: Arnav Sees an Accident
videos.overview: Anjali and Nani successfully fuel Arnav’s feelings for Khushi.  Arnav goes in search of Khushi. On the way, he sees an accident and learns about a man and woman being injured. He also happens to see Khushi’s bangles and footwear on the road. Did Khushi meet with an accident?

videos.title: Arnav Gets Worried
videos.overview: Nani threatens to break all ties with the Raizada family and forces Manorama to accept Payal as her daughter-in-law. Arnav is relieved on finding Khushi safe. He panics on seeing her injured.  Akash apologises to Payal for hiding the truth about her broken wedding from Manorama. Will Arnav reveal his feelings to Khushi?

videos.title: Arnav Buys Bangles
videos.overview: Arnav bandages Khushi’s wounds. Shyam gets displeased on learning that Arnav and Khushi came home together. Anjali and Nani are delighted about the same.  Khushi sees the bangles bought by Arnav and faints. Why does Khushi faint?

videos.title: Arnav's Admission
videos.overview: Arnav is happy on seeing Khushi wearing the bangles that he had bought. He refuses to admit that he bought the pair.  Khushi tells Anjali that she dislikes the bangles, to make him admit he bought them.  Manorama taunts the Gupta family about not making any wedding arrangements. What is Khushi's reaction to Arnav's confession?

videos.title: Arnav Realises His Love
videos.overview: Arnav plans to deliver the bride’s clothes in order to meet Khushi. Upon meeting, Arnav and Khushi share a romantic moment and get lost in each other. Meanwhile, Shyam cuts the brake wire of Anjali’s car. Will Anjali be lucky to avert the ill-fate this time around?

videos.title: Khushi Packs Payal's Things
videos.overview: Khushi is surprised to see Arnav help her serve food to the guests. She then takes her relatives to Raizada house and introduces them to Nani. Later, she packs a few memorable things for Payal to take with her. On the other side, Shyam is expectantly awaiting Anjali’s death. Will Arnav propose to Khushi?

videos.title: Anjali's Car Goes Out of Control
videos.overview: Payal gets emotional on seeing the memorable things packed by Khushi. Khushi wipes her tears with the handkerchief offered by Arnav and returns it to him. Arnav tries speaking with Khushi alone but Shyam interrupts them. Shyam rehearses grieving for Anjali’s death. Nani calls up Anjali and asks her to return home soon. Anjali panics as the car goes out of control due to brake failure. Khushi keeps the bindi that Arnav had stuck on the mirror.

videos.title: Anjali Comes to Home Injured
videos.overview: Manorama insults the Gupta family. Akash panics when Nandkishore talks about his life after marriage. Nani gets anxious about Anjali and informs Arnav about it. Shyam anticipates Anjali's death and makes arrangements for her funeral. Arnav learns about Anjali's accident from police and rushes to the spot but he receives an injured Anjali near the door. Anjali informs about the accident and requests not to tell Shyam, Akash and Gupta family. Arnav cries for Anjali even though she is fine.

videos.title: Shyam Manhandles Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav tends to Anjali’s injuries. He then decides to profess his love to Khushi. Meanwhile, Khushi reads a message on the mirror and goes to the terrace to meet Arnav. To her surprise, she finds Shyam, who forcefully embraces her as she tries to run away. Arnav notices this. How will he react?

videos.title: Anjali Stays Alive
videos.overview: Arnav is devastated to see Shyam profess his love to Khushi. Khushi warns Shyam to stay away. Later, Shyam is shocked on learning that Anjali is alive. Meanwhile, Arnav decides to tell Anjali the truth about Shyam and Khushi. Shyam shamelessly challenges him to do so.

videos.title: Arnav Discloses Shyam's Truth
videos.overview: Shyam dares Arnav to tell the truth to Anjali. But just as Arnav prepares to do so, Anjali faints. Meanwhile, Khushi is looking for Arnav to tell him the truth about Shyam. Later, Shyam is worried about Arnav revealing the truth to Anjali.

videos.title: Khushi Changes Her Mind
videos.overview: Anjali shares the news of her pregnancy with Shyam and Arnav. Shyam pretends to care for her and the baby. Meanwhile, Khushi changes her mind about informing Arnav about Shyam. Akash and Payal on the other hand, get ready for their wedding. Why does Khushi change her mind suddenly?

videos.title: Akash and Payal Get Married
videos.overview: Upon Arnav’s arrival, Payal and Akash exchange garlands. Arnav threatens to stop the wedding if Khushi doesn’t obey him. Khushi agrees and the ceremony proceeds smoothly. Manorama unwillingly welcomes Payal into the house. Meanwhile, Shyam gets suspicious on seeing their grim faces.

videos.title: Arnav Marries Khushi
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked on seeing Arnav and Khushi as the newly-wed couple. Anjali and Nani demand an explanation for their sudden wedding. But Arnav and Khushi remain silent. What is the secret behind their secret wedding?

videos.title: Khushi Is Insulted by All
videos.overview: Arnav refuses to answer any questions and locks himself in his room. He orders Khushi to stay in his house for six months as his wife. Manorama insults the Gupta family for Khush’s actions. Nani and Anjali also berate her for demeaning the sanctity of marriage. Will Khushi reveal the truth to everyone?

videos.title: Arnav Warns Shyam to Be Away From Khushi
videos.overview: Madhumati taunts Khushi for repaying the kindness with humiliation. Payal disowns Khushi for humiliating their family and refusing to give a reason for her actions. Raizada family is desolate after the wedding ceremony. Khushi tells Arnav that he has made her an orphan once again by forcing her to marry him. She demands to know why he had married her. Arnav refuses to answer her questions. Arnav warns Shyam not to go near Khushi now as she is his wife.

videos.title: Nani Falls Sick
videos.overview: Payal distributes puja prasadh to everyone except Khushi. Manorama taunts them. Shyam confronts Khushi for betraying him by marrying Arnav. Nani falls sick. Anjali blames Arnav for Nani's illness. Nani refuses to talk to Khushi. Arnav threatens to leave Raizada's house with Khushi if his family does not accept their marriage. Nani rejects the food prepared by Khushi. Anjali and Nani decide not to forgive Arnav for humiliating their family.

videos.title: Anjali Asks Khushi to Perform the Rituals as Per Raizada's Custom
videos.overview: Anjali calls a family meeting and announces that Khushi will not be accepted as a daughter-in-law of the Raizada family until the ritual is performed as per the custom. She gives bridal dress and jewellery to Khushi and instructs her to get ready. Khushi recalls her dreams about her wedding. She thinks of the reality and cries. Anjali welcomes Arnav and Khushi while Manorama and Shyam fume in anger. Arnav is forced to carry Khushi into the house. Khushi's earring gets stuck in his coat.

videos.title: Pretending to Be Happy
videos.overview: Anjali takes Khushi to Arnav’s room. Arnav instructs her to look happy in front of his family. Later, he sees Khushi shivering in cold weather and offers her a blanket. In the morning, Anjali takes Khushi to the kitchen, to which Manorama objects. Will the Raizadas accept Khushi?

videos.title: Khushi Fights With Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi fights with Arnav for subjecting her to such misery. Arnav feels sad to see her being ignored by her family and insulted by Manorama. Meanwhile, Nani lets Khushi be a part of the family function despite Manorama’s disapproval. Later, Khushi demands the truth from Arnav.

videos.title: Arnav Insults the Guests
videos.overview: When Khushi’s dress is spoiled, she wears Arnav’s shirt, which also gets torn off. Meanwhile, Arnav finds Manorama spying on them and pretends to romance with Khushi. Later at the party, Arnav insults the guests for gossiping about him and Khushi. Will there be an end to Khushi’s miseries?

videos.title: Madhumati Takes Payal Home
videos.overview: Khushi tries to cheer up Payal, but fails to do so. She then tries to find solace in Nani’s pet goat, Lakshmi. Later, Madhumati arrives at the Raizada house to invite Payal for the rituals. However, she ignores Khushi. Anjali then asks Arnav to drop Khushi to Madhumati’s house for the ritual. Will Arnav agree?

videos.title: Arnav Searches for Khushi
videos.overview: At Madhumati’s house, Khushi apologises to everyone. But Madhumati throws her out of the house. Khushi goes to the temple for refuge. Meanwhile, Payal calls up Arnav to enquire about Khushi. Arnav soon realises that Khushi is missing and sets out to search her. Will he be able to find her?

videos.title: Arnav Confronts Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav forcefully brings Khushi home and warns her not to step out of the house without informing him. Meanwhile, Akash tells Anjali that Khushi wasn’t allowed to perform the Pag Phere Rasam. Later, Arnav confronts Khushi for hurting him. In retaliation, Khushi decides to learn the truth from Arnav.

videos.title: Payal Tries to Impress Manorama
videos.overview: Manorama accuses Payal and Madhumati of purposely deleting her footage from Akash's wedding video. Payal's efforts to impress her with her favourite dishes fail. Meanwhile, Khushi suggests making sugar-free sweets. Will Payal impress Manorama?

videos.title: Khushi Leaves the Raizada House
videos.overview: Manorama berates Payal for burning the kheer. Akash defends Payal. Khushi decides to leave the Raizada house when Arnav refuses to answer her questions. In turn, Arnav threatens to ruin Payal's marriage. Khushi disregards his threats and tells Anjali that Arnav had ordered her to go back to her parent's house. Shyam tries to get close to Khushi while dropping her home but she gets out of his car in the middle of the road. Anjali, Nani and Manorama question Arnav for sending Khushi home.

videos.title: Akash's Assurance
videos.overview: Arnav tells Anjali that he sent Khushi to see her family. He refuses to talk to her family and asks her to return home. Akash promises to be faithful to Payal after talking to Khushi about her. Later, Khushi storms out of Arnav's office. What will Arnav do?

videos.title: Khushi Receives Divorce Papers
videos.overview: Arnav sends Payal and Akash's divorce papers to Khushi. He tells her that Akash will sign the divorce papers. Khushi sets up a meeting with Akash to talk about the matter. Arnav brings his lawyer in the meeting and tells Akash to sign the legal document. Khushi panics when Akash obediently signs. Arnav taunts her when Akash states that he is the most important person his life. Manorama torments Payal. Khushi goes to the Raizada house to stop Arnav from ruining Payal's marriage.

videos.title: Khushi Tries to Stop Payal
videos.overview: Khushi arrives at the Raizada house to stop Payal from signing the divorce papers. She snatches the papers from Arnav and threatens to jump into the pool with them. Will Arnav be able to retrieve them?

videos.title: Khushi Breaks Her Piggy Bank to Buy Holi Colours
videos.overview: Anjali talks to Shyam about Khushi and Payal's first Holi in the Raizada house. Arnav is amused to see Khushi excitedly making plans for Holi. Nani refuses to play Holi because of Arnav and Khushi's sudden marriage. Khushi vows to change Nani's decision. She breaks her piggy bank to buy Holi powder and toys for Payal. She asks Arnav for a small loan to pay for the purchases. Arnav accepts her signed draft and lends her money. Shyam tries to apply Holi powder on Khushi but she evades him.

videos.title: Khushi Prepares Bhang
videos.overview: Garima and Madhumati forgive Khushi on the auspicious occasion of Holi. Khushi performs a dance to convince Nani to play Holi. Arnav stops Shyam when he is about to put colour on Khushi. Nani orders Khushi to apply colour in return. Khush joins the cook in the preparation of bhang.

videos.title: Arnav Gets Possessive
videos.overview: Arnav is possessive about Khushi. Shyam attempts to get Kushi drunk in order to know the details of her sudden marriage. Instead, she starts telling Nani and Anjali the truth after getting drunk. However, Arnav intervenes and stops her from telling the truth. What is the truth?

videos.title: Khushi Refuses to Answer Shyam
videos.overview: Khushi refuses to tell Shyam the truth about her marriage to Arnav. Shyam finds out that Arnav and Khushi are not sleeping together when he goes to their room. Khushi is disturbed about her feelings for her husband and reveals them to him. How will Arnav react?

videos.title: Khushi Blurts Out the Truth About Her Marriage With Shyam
videos.overview: After confessing their feelings for each other, Arnav refuses to let go of Khushi's hand. An intoxicated Khushi blurts out the truth about her sudden marriage with Shyam. Arnav becomes grim again when the alcohol wears off. He is displeased when Anjali plays the video of him drinking bhang and dancing with Khushi at the Holi party. Payal tends to Manorama's inflamed face as she has an allergic reaction to the Holi powder.

videos.title: Manorama Accuses Payal
videos.overview: Arnav swaps Payal’s diabetes medicine with Manorama’s headache tablet. Manorama accuses Payal of attempting to murder her. Payal is then asked to leave the house. Meanwhile, Khushi keeps irritating Arnav to force him to send her home. How will he react?

videos.title: Khushi Irritates Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi tries her best to annoy Arnav. She fights with him over the bathroom. He thinks she is unwell and asks her to sleep in her room. Meanwhile, Manorama torments Payal, but Akash supports her. Later, Shyam misbehaves with Khushi. Will Arnav intervene?

videos.title: Khushi Irritates Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi shifts her belongings to Arnav’s bedroom. She occupies his bed, forcing him to sleep by the poolside. She then tells Anjali about her love for red roses. Later, Arnav notices Shyam buying red roses and confronts him. Is Shyam buying roses for Khushi?

videos.title: Arnav Enjoys Khushi's Food
videos.overview: Manorama’s friends tease her for participating in the fancy dress competition. While Payal encourages her to join the competition, Khushi cooks for Arnav’s colleagues. Arnav enjoys the food. The employees then make a request to Khushi. What do they want?

videos.title: Khushi Starts a Lunch Service
videos.overview: Shyam is angry with Arnav for stopping the money transfer to Anjali’s account. Khushi provides a lunch service to Arnav’s office. The canteen owner tells Arnav that he is facing losses due to this. Arnav shouts at Khushi for spoiling his image and plans to damage her business. What will he do?

videos.title: Nani Gifts Honeymoon Tickets to the Newly Married Couples
videos.overview: Shyam manipulates Anjali and buys an expensive watch at her expense. Arnav fights with Khushi on the wrong assumption that she wants to hurt Anjali because of Shyam. Shyam overhears their conversation and informs Anjali about the fight. Khushi and Arnav hide their discord from Anjali. Payal shares her ideas for the fancy dress competition with Manorama. Nani gifts honeymoon tickets to the newly married couples but Arnav cancels the trip.

videos.title: Nani and Anjali Arrange Honeymoon for the Couples in Raizada House
videos.overview: Nani and Anjali plan a honeymoon for the newly married couples in the Raizada house. They transform the house into an exotic hotel. Manorama and her husband greet the two couples. Arnav watches in anger while Shyam gifts a flower bouquet to Khushi. Arnav and Khushi are locked in their honeymoon suite without phones or electricity. Arnav lights a match to see in the dark but his laptop catches fire and Khushi panics.

videos.title: Arnav Loses His Voice
videos.overview: Arnav and Khushi fight for the couch, but end up sharing it. Khushi lights a mosquito coil and the smoke makes Arnav lose his voice. Later, everyone is amazed to see Khushi interpreting Arnav’s lip movements accurately. Meanwhile, Shyam feels that Arnav has a plan against him. What will he do?

videos.title: Khushi Calls Up the Police
videos.overview: Anjali sees Shyam in Arnav’s bedroom. Shyam tells her that he is looking for his clothes. Meanwhile, Khushi learns that all of Arnav’s new clients are frauds. She calls up the police and gets them arrested. Later, Khushi asks Arnav to thank her. How will he react?

videos.title: Khushi Cures Arnav
videos.overview: A traffic cop sees Arnav’s car parked in a no parking area. He asks Khushi for her driving licence. Arnav does not tell the cop that he is the driver. Later, Khushi cures Arnav with her herbal tonics. But he pretends to be sick. What is the reason?

videos.title: The Fancy Dress Competition
videos.overview: When Arnav and Khushi fight again, Nani compels Arnav to stay with his family during the fancy dress competition. Arnav and Khushi spend some romantic moments together. Later, Khushi forgets her script for the play and panics. Nani, however, insists Arnav to play Ranjha's role.

videos.title: Arnav Performs With Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi is pushed on stage to perform without a partner. However, Arnav performs with Khushi on Nani's insistence. The audience appreciate their performance. Later, Khushi confronts him, and asks him to complete the dialogues he had left incomplete during the play. Will Arnav express his emotions?

videos.title: Khushi Refuses the Prize Money
videos.overview: During Payal and Manorama's play, Payal falters and spoils their act. Manorama berates her, but she tells Khushi that she did it purposely to help a needy contestant win the prize money. Later, Khushi refuses the prize money. Meanwhile, Anjali feels dizzy and wants Khushi to go with Shyam to get medicines.

videos.title: Beena Appreciates Payal's Help
videos.overview: Beena thanks Payal for her help. Meanwhile, Shyam misbehaves with Khushi when they are out buying medicines. Later, Arnav accuses Khushi of trying to impress his family for property. Khushi questions their miserable marriage, but he asks her to wait for the answer. What will his answer be?

videos.title: Arnav Thinks About Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi feels left out on seeing Arnav's concern for Anjali. Arnav, on the other hand, is upset for scolding Khushi when Anjali informs him about her innocence. Later, Arnav tells Khushi that he is happy to stay away from her, but thinks about her once she goes away.

videos.title: Khushi Starts Giving Tuitions
videos.overview: Arnav is angry with Khushi for starting tuitions in Raizada house. He yells at her for making noise. Meanwhile, Khushi starts narrating a horror story to the children, but when they see Arnav, they think he is the devil from the story. How do they deal with this situation?

videos.title: Khushi, a Dutiful Wife
videos.overview: Khushi thinks Arnav is asleep, and tells Lakshmi about her plan to avoid seeing Arnav. Later, Anjali tells Arnav about Khushi's depression, but he disregards her concern. She tells Khushi about Arnav's fear of love.

videos.title: Khushi Calls Arnav Swami
videos.overview: Khushi calling Arnav "swami" amuses the whole family. Her enthusiasm for performing her wifely duties irks Arnav. Meanwhile, Akash introduces Bubbly to Payal and Khushi. Later, Khushi disrupts Arnav's meeting to serve him lunch, but Arnav rejects the food and sends her home.

videos.title: Arnav Faints
videos.overview: Khushi waits for Arnav before having dinner, but she eats everything leaving Arnav hungry and starving. He faints by the time she starts cooking for him. Anjali feeds him and reassures Khushi, leaving her feeling guilty. She stays up all night to look after him. Will Arnav appreciate her gesture?

videos.title: Arnav Lies to Khushi
videos.overview: Anjali is happy to see Khushi take care of Arnav. She tells him how Khushi stayed up all night, but he keeps lying to her about his health to get even. Khushi believes him and plans to stifle him with kindness. Later, Shyam tries to steal Arnav's locker key.

videos.title: Imprint of the Locker Key
videos.overview: Shyam plans to steals Arnav's locker key on the pretext of serving him, but Khushi is furious to see him. However, he manages to take the imprint of the key. Khushi's lipstick and scented handkerchief leaves Arnav furious. Later, Khushi decides to take Arnav to her place for a few days.

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi in Gupta House
videos.overview: Arnav agrees to go with Khushi after a lot of persuasion. Garima and Madhumati clean and prepares the house to receive Arnav. Meanwhile, Bubbly gets the soap Shyam used to get the key's imprint.  Will Shyam's wrongdoing come to light?

videos.title: Arnav Struggles to Adjust
videos.overview: Shyam saves himself by getting the soap back from Bubbly. Meanwhile, Arnav is served boiled food on Khushi's instructions. Arnav struggles to adjust with the old air conditioner breaking down, and Madhumati's friends interupting his work. Payal tries to befriend Bubbly, but Manorama intervenes.

videos.title: Arnav Hurts the Gupta Family
videos.overview: Madhumati's friends bless the couple when introduced to Arnav. However, Arnav hurts the family when he brings a new air conditioner and toiletries in the house. Later, the entire street loses power when he switches on the air conditioner.

videos.title: Khushi Challenges Arnav
videos.overview: The neighbours come to Madhumati when Arnav's air conditioner knocks out the power. Meanwhile, Arnav and Khushi fight to sleep on their favourite side. Next morning, Khushi challenges Arnav to lift weights in front of the neighbours. Will he win the challenge?

videos.title: Shyam Buys the Duplicate Key
videos.overview: Aware that the water will run out, Khushi delays Arnav's bathing time. She convinces him to take a bath under the street tap. Later, he orders food for everybody, but Madhumati pays for it from her savings. Meanwhile, Shyam purchases the duplicate key, but Akash's father sees him doing so.

videos.title: Arnav Feels Guilty
videos.overview: Arnav feels guilty for accusing Khushi. He learns about their poor financial condition, and plans to help them. He loses his temper when Khushi tries to force him to address Garima as mother. Later, they apologise to each other and the family. He admires Khushi eating the chat he buys for her.

videos.title: The Wedding Preparations
videos.overview: Khushi feeds chat to Arnav and thinks he bought it for her, but he tells that it's for everybody. Later, she invites her neighbours wedding guests to stay in Madhumati's house to irritate Arnav. He is disturbed with all the noise from the wedding preparations.

videos.title: Shyam Procures Arnav's Will
videos.overview: Madhumati tells Arnav about Khushi and Preethika's close friendship. The wedding preparations confuse him. He helps with the wedding arrangements. Meanwhile, Shyam realises that Arnav has bequeathed everything to Anjali in his will. How will Shyam take advantage of this?

videos.title: Khushi Lies About Her Wedding
videos.overview: Madhumati's neighbours ask Arnav to repair their appliances, but he agrees to do so on the condition that Khushi will go back to Shantivan with him the next day. Later in the day, Khushi gets upset when her friends ask about her wedding day and she lies about it. Arnav feels guilty on hearing it.

videos.title: Arnav Fires Preethika's Fiance
videos.overview: Arnav is furious to see a card from Shyam, and asks her to avoid him. Meanwhile, the groom's family criticises the arrangements, while Khushi tries to control the situation. In the meantime, Arnav finds out that the groom is his employee, and he fires him for not defending the bride's family.

videos.title: Arnav Saves the Wedding
videos.overview: Khushi confronts the groom's family for insulting Preethika's family. The family threaten to call off the wedding, but the groom intervenes and saves the marriage. Later, Khushi learns that Arnav saved the wedding. Khushi lies to Garima when she asks about her married life. Their conversation is overheard.

videos.title: Is Arnav Plotting?
videos.overview: Arnav feels guilty for hurting Khushi, and holds her hand while sleeping. Khushi reads his diary to find out the reason behind his behaviour. Later, she overhears Arnav’s phone conversation with Lavanya and assumes he is planning to kill her, to marry Lavanya. Will her apprehensions come true?

videos.title: Khushi's Life in Danger?
videos.overview: Arnav finds his bag torn and Khushi’s aunt thinks the rats have done it. When Arnav inquires about rat poison, Khushi suspects danger to her life. Meanwhile, Shyam plots to injure Anjali, but saves her from a fall. Did Shyam convince Anjali to stay back?

videos.title: Khushi Plans Suicide
videos.overview: Khushi is afraid of Arnav. Bubbly ruins Manorama's surprise gift, to trap Payal. Khushi decides to commit suicide, donating everything she owns to her family.

videos.title: Arnav Saves Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi plans to jump off a building. She writes Arnav a letter and bids farewell to her family. Arnav saves her and clears all accusations after reading the letter.

videos.title: Arnav Accuses Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav says he married Khushi to save Anjali's marriage. He accuses Khushi of immorality. She acts indifferent.

videos.title: Shyam's Ways Revealed to Arnav
videos.overview: Arnav learns about Khushi's broken engagement with Shyam. He refuses to believe her 'fake' stories. Meanwhile, Shyam fuels up tensions between Arnav and Khushi. She asks him to clear the air with Arnav. He asks for Arnav's sign on a legal document. Is this another trick?

videos.title: Khushi Warns Arnav About Shyam
videos.overview: Khushi refuses to get the papers signed. Anjali asks Khushi about their fight. Akash scolds Payal. Khushi and Payal hide their feelings. Khushi sews Arnav's shirt button. Why does Khushi warn him about Shyam's plan?

videos.title: Khushi Gives Into Shyam's Ploy
videos.overview: Khushi is threatened for revealing Shyam's plans. Arnav avoids her in office. Shyam gives the papers to Khushi. She removes her belongings from their room. Arnav sleeps on the sofa, ordering Khushi to sleep on the bed.

videos.title: Arnav Still Upset
videos.overview: Khushi gets the papers signed forcing Shyam to confront Arnav. Khushi learns about Anjali's mother's birthday. Shyam searches for papers in Arnav's room. Khushi asks him to meet Arnav at the airport before he leaves for London. Will the confusion clear up?

videos.title: Shyam Finds the Legal Papers
videos.overview: Shyam finds the legal papers hidden by Khushi. Anjali asks Payal to lock her cupboard. Bubbly hides inside it to get Payal into trouble. Anjali misses Arnav on her birthday. Will Khushi get the papers back?

videos.title: Arnav Messages Khushi
videos.overview: Khushi suspects Shyam to have stolen the legal papers, but he denies it. Meanwhile, Naani introduces Manorama’s brother, Chandu, to Khushi and Payal. She tells them he is absent-minded. Khushi gets an SMS from Arnav.

videos.title: Shyam Keeps Legal Papers Hidden
videos.overview: A stranger has sent an SMS to Khushi using Arnav's phone. Naani comforts Khushi with Arnav's childhood tales. Manorama gets suspicious after finding Payal's photos with Bubbly. Khushi searches Shyam's briefcase. Will she find the papers?

videos.title: Arnav Misses Business Meeting
videos.overview: Khushi worries why Arnav messaged her instead of Anjali and prays for him. Meanwhile, Arnav is missing at the London meeting. When Shyam brings food for Khushi, she insults him. Where is Arnav?

videos.title: Shyam Mistreats Khushi
videos.overview: Anjali leaves a voice message for Arnav. Khushi gets worried. Bubbly attempts to burn Akash's shirt to pick on Payal, but gets caught by Manorama. Meanwhile, Shyam misbehaves with Khushi.

videos.title: Khushi Goes to London?
videos.overview: Bubbly confesses to Akash about her misdeeds before returning to boarding school. Meanwhile, Anjali arranges for Khushi to visit Arnav in London, but Shyam protests. The trip is cancelled when Khushi learns about Arnav to have not reached London!

videos.title: Arnav Confesses His Love for Khushi
videos.overview: When Anjali does not take her medicine, Khushi pretends to receive a call from Arnav to make Anjali eat. Later, Arnav calls Anjali to inform he is in Scotland.

videos.title: Arnav Kidnapped, Held Hostage
videos.overview: Goons take Arnav hostage. Meanwhile, Khushi tries to call him but can't reach him. Khushi finds out he is not in Scotland. Akash takes Payal out for dinner. Later, Khushi files a missing complaint in the police station.

videos.title: Khushi Hires Private Detective
videos.overview: To avoid confrontation with the family, Khushi does not file the complaint. She contacts a private detective agency instead. Manorama has an eye on Khushi's. Shyam misbehaves with Khushi again.

videos.title: Khushi Shares Her Worries
videos.overview: Manorama finds out about Khushi's visit to a detective agency in Chandni Chowk. Khushi shares her fear about Arnav with Manorama. She tries to get permission to check the CCTV footage of the airport of the day when Arnav left for London.

videos.title: Manorama Lends a Helping Hand
videos.overview: Shyam doubts Khushi's behaviour. Meanwhile, Manorama too finds out that Arnav has not left India. She decides to help Khushi in her mission to look for him. Both sneak in to see the camera footage at the airport. They find out a stranger had approached Arnav at the airport.

videos.title: Khushi Spies on Shyam
videos.overview: The footage reveals that Arnav had left the airport with strangers. Khushi steals the videotape. They try to identify the kidnappers. Meanwhile, Akash plans to take Payal for a movie. Khushi keeps an eye on Shyam.

videos.title: Manorama and Khushi Get a Parcel
videos.overview: Khushi follows Shyam to a hideout. While peeping out of a window, she falls down and Shyam’s people find her. When she confronts Shyam about his heated phone conversation, he makes up an excuse. Later, Khushi gets a parcel of Arnav's medicines. Finding a clue, they go to the medical shop.

videos.title: Khushi Goes Missing
videos.overview: Khushi goes to Madhumati's house, finds one of Arnav's kidnappers on the street and follows him. The man locks her up in a room. Arnav feels Khushi's presence nearby. Akash forgets about his date with Payal. Later, Arnav finds Khushi and tries to reach her.

videos.title: Arnav-Khushi Plan Escape
videos.overview: When the kidnappers harass Khushi, Arnav beats them up. Meanwhile, Akash apologises to Payal and asks her to attend a business party, instead. Meanwhile, Arnav and Khushi escape from the kidnappers and take refuge in a hut. Do the goons find them?

videos.title: Arnav Surrenders to Kidnappers
videos.overview: Arnav presents a firefly to Khushi, setting a romantic mood. The kidnappers find them. Arnav hits Khushi on the head and covers her up to hide her from the men, and surrenders himself to save Khushi. She regains consciousness and breaks down. Where is Arnav?

videos.title: Kidnapper Threatens Khushi
videos.overview: Manorama learns that Khushi is not in Madhumati's house. Khushi returns home. Later, they get a threatening call from the kidnappers. Manorama promises to help Khushi. Can they find Arnav?

videos.title: Nandkishore Reaches Shantivan
videos.overview: Nandkishore visits the house, shocking Manorama and Khushi. He gifts Khushi a pendant with Arnav and her picture. Meanwhile, Payal is out of place at the party and is taken to her parents' house. Later, Khushi and Manorama visit a tattoo parlour. Can they identify the kidnapper there?

videos.title: Manorama and Khushi Sneak In
videos.overview: While Khushi finds the kidnapper's address, she gets another threat from him. Khushi and Manorama hide in a mall on realising they are being followed. They reach the address and search for clues. Will the kidnapper find them?

videos.title: Arnav's Escape Plan Fails
videos.overview: Manorama and Khushi escape, throwing chilli powder into the kidnapper's eyes. They find an address at the kidnapper’s house and reach there. Arnav tries to escape, but fails.

videos.title: Shyam Plans Kidnap
videos.overview: Goons beat up Arnav for attacking Shyam. Shyam spares his life in order to get his money. While Khushi prays for Arnav, Nani, Anjali and Payal try to cheer her up. What is Arnav's fate?

videos.title: Nandkishore Learns About Kidnap
videos.overview: Khushi sees blood on Shyam's shoe and gets suspicious. She swabs the blood from his shoe and gives it for testing. Results confirm the blood group to be Arnav's. Nandkishore learns about Arnav's kidnap from Khushi. He disbelieves that Shyam is a criminal. Can Khushi catch Shyam red-handed?

videos.title: Nandkishore Lends Support
videos.overview: Nandkishore helps Khushi with her mission. Anjali receives a call from a travel agency about Shyam's false vacation plans and organises raksha puja for her baby. Khushi sneaks in and goes through Shyam's briefcase, while the family attends the puja. Later, she finds the briefcase key.

videos.title: Arnav's Boarding Pass With Shyam
videos.overview: Arnav's boarding pass is found in the briefcase. Nandkishore replaces it in the briefcase, while Khushi distracts Shyam. Shyam makes a false entry in Arnav's name for a flight to Scotland, through a travel agency. Khushi asks for a huge sum of money from Anjali, which makes Shyam suspicious.

videos.title: Arnav Finds the Kidnapper's Phone
videos.overview: Shyam confronts Khushi when he sees paying a man to get Arnav's signature. Khushi tells him that she wants to take revenge, and destroy him by taking over his wealth. Arnav gets hold of the kidnappers phone and calls Khushi. She tells him that Shyam is the real kidnapper but he fails to hear her.

videos.title: Khushi Gains Shyam's Trust
videos.overview: Khushi and Shyam leave together, Anjali grows suspicious. To gain Shyam's trust, Khushi signs the fake legal papers and tells him about Arnav's call. Shyam too tries to win her over. Khushi and Nandkishore use Shyam to find Arnav. Arnav and Khushi dream about each other.

videos.title: Shyam Tracked by Suspicious Duo
videos.overview: The couple miss each other and imagine a happy life. Shyam offers a candle to a scared Khushi after a power cut. Nandkishore and Khushi track Shyam's whereabouts. Payal is uneasy with Akash's colleagues, but Madhumati helps her cope. Anjali is shocked to see Khushi feeding Shyam. Khushi follows Shyam.

videos.title: Shyam Is Followed Discreetly
videos.overview: Nandkishore and Khushi discreetly follow Shyam to his meeting with the goons. Shyam spots their car and postpones the meeting. Meanwhile, Khushi chats with Naani to allay Shyam's suspicion. Nani asks Khushi about Arnav, forcing her to lie.  Shyam withdraws a large sum. Nandkishore checks Shyam's mails.

videos.title: Arnav Sends a Note to Khushi
videos.overview: Naani asks Khushi about Arnav's whereabouts. Shyam asks kidnappers to buy gifts and send to the house as an alibi. Arnav puts a note inside for Khushi. Payal obeys Madhumati's advise and seduces Akash, it backfires. Khushi ties a protective charm around Shyam's neck to get hold of his locket.

videos.title: Khushi Finds Shyam's Pendrive
videos.overview: Khushi puts a fake locket in place. The original one is a password protected pendrive. The gifts in Arnav's name arrive. Naani is ecstatic, but Manorama grows suspicious of the Scotland stamp and demands to be involved in the search. Khushi reassures her of Arnav's return.

videos.title: Shyam Is Watched
videos.overview: Nandkishore sneaks a spy camera in Shyam's room. It records all his actions. The password, I LOVE YOU KHUSHI, is tracked while Shyam types it on the laptop. Khushi and Nandkishore are shocked at this revelation. Khushi tricks Shyam to say I Love You to her and records it for later use.

videos.title: Khushi Seeks Shyam's Divorce
videos.overview: Nandkishore helps Khushi find the laptop's password. The family is shocked to see the will. Later, Akash chides Payal. Meanwhile, Kushi asks Shyam to divorce Anjali. What will Shyam do?

videos.title: Khushi Influences Shyam's Divorce
videos.overview: Khushi tricks Shyam into signing the divorce paper, but Manorama grows suspicious of her behaviour. Later, she informs Anjali about Shyam and Khushi.

videos.title: Arnav Hides a Bill in a Gift
videos.overview: Khushi receives Arnav's hotel bill in the gift he sends, thus learning the location of the hotel near where he is trapped. Meanwhile, Anjali refuses to listen to Manaroma regarding Khushi and Shyam's affair. Later, Shyam learns about Nandkishore and Khushi's  investigation.

videos.title: Khushi Discovers Arnav's Location
videos.overview: Shyam learns about Khushi's intention of finding Arnav, while Anjali is desperate to prove Manorama wrong. Khushi succeeds in reaching Arnav's place of confinement, but Shyam nabs her before she can enter.

videos.title: Khushi Falls Into a Trench
videos.overview: Arnav escapes, but Shyam forces Khushi in his car. Arnav follows him, while the goons chase him. He finds Khushi tied up on the road and as he tries to fee her, the goons attack him. Khushi, however, frees herself, falls into a trench with the goons in pursuit.

videos.title: Manorama Reveals Arnav's Kidnap
videos.overview: Khushi informs Arnav that Shyam kidnapped him. When Anjali panics on seeing Shyam injured, he lies to her. Manorama continues with her effort of hiding the truth. Injured, Khushi and Arnav return home. Later, Manorama spills the beans about the kidnapping.

videos.title: Khushi Exposes Shyam
videos.overview: Khushi exposes Shyam's intention for kidnapping Arnav. Shyam denies, and asks her to prove the same. Anjali does not believe that Shyam is the culprit. Meanwhile, Nandkishore enters and corroborates Khushi's claim.

videos.title: Anjali Does Not Believe Khushi
videos.overview: Shyam accuses Khushi of tainting his image, while Manorma asks Payal to not defend Khushi. When Nandkishore talks about the pen drive and the will, Shyam hides the drive. Anjali disbelieves Khushi and Nandkishore. Manorama says Khushi asked Shyam to divorce Anjali.

videos.title: Arnav Slaps Shyam
videos.overview: Shyam says that Khushi tried to seduce him and Payal challenges his accusation. She says he pretended to be a bachelor to stay at Madhumati's house and get engaged to Khushi. Shyam asks for proof, but Khushi fails. Later, Arnav slaps Shyam and throws him out when he accuses Khushi of immorality.

videos.title: Anjali Strays From Arnav
videos.overview: Anjali faints after Arnav throws Shyam out of the house. Shyam's deceit devastates everyone. Payal pleads with Akash to trust Khushi and her, but he rebuffs her. Anjali does not believe Arnav and distances herself from him. Meanwhile, Arnav comforts Khushi.

videos.title: Nani Protects Anjali From Khushi
videos.overview: Akash is upset as Payal hides Shyam's truth. He blames her for the tragedy in the family. Meanwhile, Naani worries about Anjali's pregnancy and asks Khushi to stay away from her. Anjali is upset, while Khushi looks after Arnav.

videos.title: Anjali Decides to Abort Her Baby
videos.overview: Arnav cheers up Khushi. She insists Anjali to eat for her baby's sake. However, Anjali runs away, making the Raizada family anxious. She tries to abort the baby in a hospital. Meanwhile, Nani and Manorama condemn Khushi for ignoring their advice. Later, Arnav reaches the nursing home. Will he find Anjali?

videos.title: Arnav Convinces Anjali
videos.overview: Anjali tries to abort the baby herself after the doctor's refusal. Arnav convinces her to change her mind and return home. Meanwhile, Manorama blames Khushi and Payal for the family's misfortunes. Anjali wants Arnav to make Shyam come back.  Arnav, too, blames Khushi for everything that is going wrong.

videos.title: Khushi Decides to Leave the House
videos.overview: Khushi blames herself for Shyam's misconduct. Meanwhile, Arnav threatens to break Payal's marriage if Khushi leaves. He vows to win her back before the contract marriage ends. Later, Nani says Khushi is in Madhumati's house, which makes Arnav upset.

videos.title: Khushi's Surprise Birthday Bash
videos.overview: Khushi complains when Arnav forgets her birthday. Later, she thanks Aman for a gift that Arnav had asked him to bring. While Payal cooks for Khushi, Manorama causes a fight between Akash and Payal. Meanwhile, Anjali receives the red roses ordered for Khushi, thinking they are for her.

videos.title: Anjali Realises Her Mistake
videos.overview: Arnav lies to Anjali about the roses to keep her happy. Khushi, meanwhile, receives gifts from Payal and Nandkishore. To surpise Khushi, Arnav lights up the poolside and then forces her to cut the cake. Anjali sees Arnav feeding the cake to Khushi, realises her mistake and throws away the flowers.

videos.title: Arnav Tries to Impress Khushi
videos.overview: Arnav places a red rose on Khushi's pillow and finally wishes her, thinking she is asleep. Later, Nandkishore tells Arnav to be unique. Nani cooks a special dish for Khushi on Arnav's request, but Khushi doesn’t eat. Meanwhile, Akash is still upset about Payal.

videos.title: Khushi Rejects Arnav's Gift
videos.overview: Khushi refuses to accept Arnav's gift, making him angry. Anjali's turmoil, Manorama's anger and Payal and Akash's misunderstandings upset Khushi. Her attempt to reconcile Payal and Akash's rift also backfires. Meanwhile, Anjali tells Nani that she wants a son like Shyam.

videos.title: Khushi Spurns Arnav's Advances
videos.overview: Manorama blames Khushi for Anjali's failed marriage. Arnav attempts to make Khushi smile and reignite her feelings, but to no avail. Khushi refuses to accept him as her husband. Anjali asks Arnav to attend to business in Agra and asks Khushi to accompany him, but Khushi refuses.

videos.title: Payal Pleads for Forgiveness
videos.overview: Arnav plans to scare and then surprise Khushi, hoping that she will appreciate his efforts. Instead, she gets angry at him for scaring her. Anjali thinks that Arnav lied to her about the meeting in Agra. Payal requests Akash to forgive her, but Manorama interferes in their matters.

videos.title: Arnav Explains His Feelings
videos.overview: Arnav tells Anjali that although he married Khushi to save her from Shyam, he has now truly fallen in love with her. He reassures Anjali that their brother-sister relationship will remain strong. While Akash forgives Payal, Khushi feels elated when Anjali talks to her.

videos.title: Khushi Lies to Arnav
videos.overview: Khushi lies to Arnav about going to the Guptas' house to tend to Madhumati. Naani calls Madhumati but Khushi intercepts the call. Akash asks Payal to accompany him to Mumbai, but she declines, fearing Manorama. Arnav visits the Guptas to enquire about Madhumati. How will Khushi handle this?

videos.title: Arnav Questions Khushi's Lie
videos.overview: Arnav brings a doctor to treat Madhumati. Khushi fabricates a story to fool the doctor. Manorama spots Anjali meeting someone secretly. On learning that Madhumati hasn't paid her rent yet, Arnav pays for her. Khushi scolds him for doing so. He confronts her for lying about Madhumatis illness.

videos.title: Arnav Vows to Win Khushi's Love
videos.overview: Manorama wonders who made blank calls to the house. She sees Anjali talking to herself and tells Naani. Arnav vows to cement his and Khushi's marriage. As part of a plan, Arnav cancels the cheque to pay Madhumati's rent. The landlord demands the rent in a day. How will Khushi arrange the money?

videos.title: Khushi Seeks Arnav's Help
videos.overview: Khushi runs from pillar to post to arrange the money, but to no avail. So she reluctantly seeks Arnav's help. He asks her to work for him for a day in exchange for the money. Khushi hurts her foot while catering to Arnav. Arnav immediately tends to her injured foot. Will this draw them closer?

videos.title: Khushi Tends to Arnav's Back
videos.overview: While tending to Khushi, Arnav falls and hurts his back. Khushi massages his back with oil. Later, Anjali shows him the sonogram of her baby. Arnav asks Khushi to stay up all night. She retaliates by calling him every few minutes and disturbing his sleep throughout the night.

videos.title: Arnav Becomes the New Landlord
videos.overview: The landlord informs Khushi that a new developer has bought the house. Khushi learns that Arnav is the new developer and also her new landlord. Arnav threatens to demolish the house when she refuses to return to Shantivan. He cuts the water and electricity supply to the Gupta house.

videos.title: Arnav Asks the Guptas to Vacate
videos.overview: Anjali meets Madhumati and Garima when they take Shashi to the hospital. Anjali learns that Madhumati is not sick and that Khushi and Arnav lied to her. Arnav orders Khushi to return to Shantivan. When she refuses, Arnav threatens to tell her family about their contract marriage.

videos.title: Khushi Returns With Arnav
videos.overview: Arnav brings Khushi back home. Akash returns from Mumbai. On the days of Rakhi, Arnav wears a set of traditional clothes gifted to him by Anjali. Anjali ties rakhi to Arnav, Akash and Nandkishore. She receives a call from someone and hides it from the family. What is she hiding?

videos.title: Arnav's Grandmother Goes Missing
videos.overview: Khushi sees Anjali talking to someone outside the house. Arnav gifts Khushi a pearl necklace and some of her favourite things. Naani tells Arnav that his grandmother, Subhadra Devi is missing from the ashram. While they go looking of her, Manorama tells Akash that Subhadra suffered from a mental ailment.

videos.title: Subhadra Devi Visits Shantivan
videos.overview: Khushi accidentally pours dirty water on Subhadra Devi when she comes to Shantivan. Thinking that Khushi is a servant, Subhadra Devi insults her. She also forbids her from entering her room and scolds Manorama for letting Khushi decorate the puja room. How will Khushi clear the misunderstanding?

videos.title: Arnav Supports Khushi
videos.overview: Naani introduces Khushi to Subhadra Devi (Daadi), who rebuffs her. Daadi questions Naani for not informing her about several matters. Naani reminds Daadi that she had deserted the family in the past. Arnav defends Khushi when Daadi forbids her from entering her room.

videos.title: Arnav Talks About His Mother
videos.overview: Daadi’s sudden arrival reminds Arnav of the past and he has a restless night. He tells Khushi that his mother committed suicide. Khushi comforts him. On Anjali's behest, Khushi goes to the storeroom and finds old photos. Daadi scolds her for going through the photos, but Arnav defends Khushi.

videos.title: Khushi Deems Wedding Incomplete
videos.overview: Daadi asks Manorama about Shyam, but Nandkishore intervenes. Khushi and Arnav share a number of endearing moments, including jumping and breaking the bed. Khushi tells Arnav that their wedding is incomplete without fulfilling the ceremonial customs. Will Arnav agree to do it?

videos.title: Khushi Gets Flustered
videos.overview: Arnav tells Khushi to get ready for their wedding night. This flusters her and she wears her dress inside out and makes jalebis instead of kheer for Janmashtami. Anjali secretly goes out to meet someone. Daadi questions Arnav for throwing Shyam out. She also criticizes Arnav's mother, enraging him.

videos.title: Arnav Decorates the Bedroom
videos.overview: Manorama doubts Anjali's suspicious behaviour. Arnav gifts a dress to Khushi and decorates their bedroom with flowers and candle lights. Khushi refuses to consummate their marriage without a proper wedding. Arnav builds a fire on the terrace and carries her around it. Daadi sees them together.

videos.title: Shyam Spies on Shantivan
videos.overview: Daadi reveals that Arnav and Khushi's wedding was a contractual engagement. Arnav decides to fulfil all the customs and rituals. Madhumati takes Khushi to the Gupta house. Shyam, who has been keeping an eye on Shantivan through discreetly placed cameras, vows to prevent the wedding.

videos.title: Daadi Insults Khushi
videos.overview: Daadi visits the Guptas and insults Khushi for living with Arnav without a proper wedding. While Garima slaps Khushi, Madhumati defends Khushi and breaks the alliance. Arnav tells the two families that the wedding will take place at any cost. Later in the night, Shyam sneaks into Shantivan.

videos.title: Daadi Wishes to Meet Garima
videos.overview: Daadi criticizes Khushi and her values, while Naani defends her. On hearing about Garima, Daadi insists on meeting her. Garima panics when she hears this. Arnav tells Daadi that Khushi was adopted by the Guptas after her parents' death.

videos.title: Garima Goes Out to Avoid Daadi
videos.overview: Daadi postpones meeting Garima till the next day. To avoid meeting Daadi, Garima goes out. Daadi tells Arnav that he is not allowed to see the bride until the wedding. He refutes her suggestion and meets Khushi after the completion of the shagun.

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi Get Engaged
videos.overview: Garima uses Shashi's illness as reason not to attend the engagement. This displeases Daadi. Arnav goes through all the customs for Khushi's sake. Shyam sneaks into Shantivan during the function. After the ceremony, Arnav and Khushi spends some romantic moments together.
