videos.title: Arnav Finds a Bill for Cameras
videos.overview: Shyam tampers with Anjali's medicine. Arnav hires a nurse for Shashi so that Garima can attend a puja. Arnav notices a bill in Shyam's name for camera equipment. Anjali goes out to meet someone while the rest of the family goes to the temple to meet Khushi's family.

videos.title: Anjali Invites Shyam Home
videos.overview: Garima sees Daadi and goes home. Arnav not only enters the temple for the first time, he participates in the puja to make Khushi happy. On learning that the family is at the temple, Anjali invites Shyam to Shantivan. Shyam tells her that he is fed up of meeting her secretly.

videos.title: Anjali Takes Tampered Medicine
videos.overview: With Shyam still at home, Anjali panics when the family returns. Shyam hides, but Daadi sees his mobile. While the doctor prescribes new medicines for Anjali, before leaving, Shyam makes her take the tampered medicines. Garima tells that she is taking Shashi to a medical camp for a week.

videos.title: Daadi Promises to Help Shyam
videos.overview: Madhumati asks Garima to postpone the trip to the medical camp for Khushi's wedding. It is revealed that Shyam and Daadi have an understanding and Daadi promises to help him regain his place. Khushi asks Arnav to meet her at a restaurant. Shyam arranges to meet Anjali at the same restaurant.

videos.title: Khushi and Arnav Go on a Date
videos.overview: Khushi and Arnav meet at a restaurant and Shyam and Anjali happen to meet at the same place. Anjali asks Shyam to attend her godh bharai ritual. Shyam gifts her jewellery and promises to come for the ritual, but in disguise. Will someone spot him?

videos.title: Shyam Wears a Disguise
videos.overview: Shyam enters Shantivan in disguise. Garima decides to meet Daadi to sort things out. When guests wonder why Shyam isn't present, Daadi asks Naani to invite Shyam. Arnav refuses to invite him. To calm Arnav, Nandkishore arranges a party for him in his room.

videos.title: Shyam Tries to Harm Anjali
videos.overview: Arnav tells Daadi that he wishes to forget the tragic past. Garima overhears this and decides not to meet Daadi. Meanwhile, Shyam, still in disguise, litters the doormat in Anjali’s room with broken glass. Naani allows Arnav to participate in Khushi's mehendi rasam.

videos.title: Garima Meets Daadi in the Dark
videos.overview: Anjali recognizes Shyam despite his disguise. When Arnav almost recognizes Shyam, Anjali switches off the lights. Manorama introduces Garima to Daadi in the dark. Having littered the doormat with broken glass in Anjali’s room, Shyam hides Anjali's footwear and asks her to meet him in her room.

videos.title: Shyam Sets a Trap for Anjali
videos.overview: Anjali goes to her room to meet Shyam and steps on the broken glass. Shyam sets a trap with live electrical wires on the staircase rail. Anjali comes in contact with the wires and falls down. She is rushed to the hospital. But will the fall harm her baby?

videos.title: Anjali Breaks Down
videos.overview: A distraught Anjali refuses to believe that her baby is dead. Later, when the news about her miscarriage sinks in, Anjali breaks down and cries bitterly. A devastated Arnav shares his grief with Khushi, who comforts him.

videos.title: Shyam Plans His Return
videos.overview: At Khushi's behest, a hesitant Arnav meets and comforts Anjali. Shyam pretends to be devastated by the miscarriage. Arnav beats him and tries to throw him out, but Daadi intervenes. Shyam plans to use Anjali's miscarriage to return to Shantivan. Arnav warns everyone not to allow Shyam back.

videos.title: Daadi Fights for Shyam
videos.overview: Daadi fights for Shyam's return, but Arnav refuses. He tells her that Shyam had tried to kill him, which she refuses to believe. Arnav plans to get a restraining order against Shyam. Meanwhile, Shyam manipulates an already hysterical Anjali to enter Shantivan. Will Anjali ask Arnav to bring Shyam back?

videos.title: Daadi Blames Khushi
videos.overview: Anjali gives in to Shyam's manipulation and pleads with Arnav to bring him back, but he refuses. Enraged, Daadi blames Khushi. She further compares Khushi to the woman responsible for the death of Arnav's parents and prevents her from tending to Anjali. Will these tactics affect Arnav?

videos.title: Khushi Sees Shyam in Shantivan
videos.overview: Shyam sneaks into Shantivan to meet Anjali, who displays a sudden burst of happiness. Khushi sees Shyam sneaking out of Anjali's room and realizes that he made Anjali happy. She decides to talk to Arnav about it. Meanwhile, Madhumati plans to visit Anjali but Garima hesitates to go to Shantivan.

videos.title: Khushi Brings Shyam Back
videos.overview: Pining for Shyam, Anjali accuses her family of only pretending to care for her. With Anjali's refusal to eat and deteriorating health, Khushi brings Shyam back against Arnav's decision. Anjali is pleased to see Shyam. How will Arnav react?

videos.title: Arnav Asks Khushi to Leave
videos.overview: Arnav feels that Khushi has broken his trust by bringing Shyam back. In a fit of rage, he asks Khushi to leave. Shyam apologizes to the Raizadas and says what happened was a misunderstanding. Arnav warns him that he will be thrown out once Anjali recovers. Later, Arnav calls Khushi. Will she answer?

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi Patch Up
videos.overview: Khushi feels guilty for disconnecting Arnav's call. She calls him back but he doesn't pick up. Anjali and Naani persuade Arnav to forgive Khushi. Manorama and Nandkishore also try to bring them together. Anjali performs Khushi's second mehendi ritual. Arnav apologizes to Khushi. Will they reconcile?

videos.title: Khushi's Haldi Ritual
videos.overview: Arnav thanks Khushi for doing what was needed for Anjali's happiness. Daadi and Shyam conspire to stop the wedding. The Raizadas surprise the Guptas by performing the haldi rasam in the Gupats' house. Will the ritual go on without any hitches?

videos.title: Shyam Admires Khushi's Beauty
videos.overview: Shashi is displeased to see Shyam in his house, but Garima tells him that he has reformed himself. Shyam, who is shooting the ritual on his camera, secretly admires Khushi's beauty. Garima panics when Madhumati asks her to apply haldi on Daadi. Shyam notices Garima's anxiety.

videos.title: Shyam Plans to Expose Garima
videos.overview: Daadi doesn't recognize Garima due to the haldi on her face. Shyam, who has been observing Garima, sees her hiding a box in her cupboard. Daadi tells him that a woman named Garima Gupta is responsible for Arnav's parents' suicide. Shyam then plans to reveal Garima's secret.

videos.title: Daadi Confronts Garima
videos.overview: Shyam manages to bring Garima and Daadi before each other. Daadi accuses Garima of breaking up her family by having an extramarital affair with Arnav's father. She decides to use this as a reason to stop the wedding. Garima begs her not to punish Khushi for her mistake.

videos.title: Daadi Gifts Khushi Bangles
videos.overview: Garima tells Daadi that she was unaware that Arnav's father was married during their affair. Daadi refuses to believe her and threatens to reveal her secret to Arnav. Later, surprisingly, she gifts Khushi a pair of bangles which is a family heirloom. What are Daadi's plans?

videos.title: Shyam Gets Garima's Secret Box
videos.overview: At the sangeet ceremony, Daadi acts friendly with Garima. Shyam finds the box that Garima was hiding and sees a photo of her with Arnav's father. Daadi says that she will punish Khushi for this. Shyam makes a copy of the photo and decides to wait for an opportunity.

videos.title: Arnav Proposes to Khushi
videos.overview: An overjoyed Arnav dances in the sangeet ceremony and formally proposes to Khushi. Khushi asks Nandkishore to organize a bachelor’s party for Arnav. Shyam misplaces the photo of Garima and Arnav's father, but somebody finds it. Who has the photo?

videos.title: Arnav's Bachelor's Party
videos.overview: Payal scolds Khushi and explains that a bachelor's party involves liquor and other women. Arnav reveals that the party was a setup to fool her. He then surprises Khushi with a planetary show in the farm house. They spend romantic time together and profess their love for each other.

videos.title: Daadi Reveals Garima's Secret
videos.overview: While getting ready for the wedding, Khushi breaks the bangles gifted by Arnav. Garima reminisces of the time when Khushi accepted her as her mother. While going to the hall, Daadi tells Arnav that Garima is responsible for breaking up their family and shows him the photo of Garima and his father.

videos.title: Arnav Doesn't Come to the Hall
videos.overview: Arnav doesn't come to the wedding hall. Daadi reveals Garima's secret to the two families in front of the guests. Garima tries to explain that she was unaware of Arnav's father's marital status, but Daadi insults her. Khushi and Payal defend Garima.

videos.title: Daadi Breaks the Alliance
videos.overview: Daadi breaks Arnav and Khushi's alliance and takes back the bangles that she had given to Khushi. Payal refuses to be with the Raizadas after Garima's humiliation. Anjali worries about Arnav. While Khushi is still hopeful that Arnav will return, Arnav remembers the past and cries.

videos.title: Arnav Singh Raizada Comes to the Wedding Hall Injured From an Accident
videos.overview: Arnav Singh Raizada recalls his late mother's advice about not hurting the people he loves for a crime they did not commit. He meets with an accident on his way to the wedding hall. Garima Gupta apologises to Khushi Kumari Gupta for ruining her wedding day. Payal Gupta and Madhumati Gupta persuade Khushi to go home with them. Khushi Kumari Gupta tells them that Arnav Singh Raizada had promised to marry her and she does not want to break his trust by leaving. She waits for Arnav Singh Raizada at the wedding hall until the fire in the havan fizzles. Arnav Singh Raizada comes to the hall injured.

videos.title: Arnav and Khushi Get Married
videos.overview: Arnav decides to marry Khushi. When Daadi reminds him about Garima, Arnav tells her that his father is to be blamed for deceiving two innocent women and committing suicide due to the shame. Arnav and Khushi prepare to get married. Will everything work out this time?

videos.title: Arnav Notices the Spy Cam
videos.overview: On their wedding night, Arnav and Khushi find out the spy camera that Shyam had installed in Arnav’s room. Both Arnav and Khushi learn from Anjali that Shyam has been working on his laptop the entire night. What will they do next?

videos.title: Arnav Sneaks Into Shyam’s Room
videos.overview: When the family assembles to unwrap Khushi and Arnav’s wedding gifts, they sneak into Shyam’s room to check his laptop. Will they find the videos captured by the spy camera?

videos.title: Shyam Is Guilty
videos.overview: Looking at the videos in Shyam’s laptop, Khushi and Arnav are convinced he is responsible for Anjali’s miscarriage. What will Khusi do to bring the truth to light?

videos.title: Khushi Plots Against Shyam
videos.overview: When Arnav decides to hand Shyam over to the police for causing Anjali’s miscarriage, Khushi asks him to first gather proof against Shyam. Later, Khushi and Nandkishore scheme against Shyam to acquire proof. Will Shyam learn about their tricks?

videos.title: Shyam Accuses Anjali
videos.overview: Khushi replaces the medicine given by Anjali to Shyam with a bottle of abortion pills. Shyam accuses Anjali of giving him the wrong medicine. When will Khushi expose unveil Shyam’s reality in front of Anjali?

videos.title: Shyam Gets Electrocuted
videos.overview: Shyam gets electrocuted after touching the fairy lights hidden in the rangoli done by Anjali to surprise him on their wedding anniversary. Anjali apologises to him. Later, Arnav requests Anjali to tie a rakhi on his hand. Why?

videos.title: Khushi Exposes Shyam
videos.overview: Nandkishore and Khushi expose Shyam in front of the family by revealing the videos, which show him doctoring Anjali’s medicines, placing pieces of glass in her room and fiddling with electrical wires and planning Anjali’s miscarriage. Will Shyam confess to his crimes?

videos.title: Anjali Slaps Shyam
videos.overview: Shyam confesses his crimes in front of the Raizadas. A devastated Anjali slaps him. Arnav throws him out of the house. Meanwhile, Nandkishore calls up the police. Will Anjali let Shyam get arrested?

videos.title: Khushi and Arnav Go for a Movie
videos.overview: While Arnav decides to take Khushi for horse racing, she persuades him to watch a movie instead. The rest of the family members also join them for the movie. But Arnav and Khushi are made to sit apart in the theatre!

videos.title: Arnav’s Birthday Plan
videos.overview: To please Arnav, Khushi plans to wear a modern dress and watch an English movie with him. She even organises a fashion show in his office. For Arnav’s birthday, she decides to throw a party. Will Arnav appreciate her efforts?

videos.title: Raizadas Don’t Wish Arnav
videos.overview: Arnav is saddened when none of his family members wish him on his birthday. Khushi serves him the usual home food. Even when a client sends a birthday cake to Shantivan, Khushi sends it back.

videos.title: Arnav Prepares Jalebis
videos.overview: When Arnav gets upset with Khushi for not wishing him on his birthday, she explains she was forced to do so as he doesn’t appreciate celebrating his birthday. Now, Khushi is upset with Arnav. As an apology, Arnav prepares jalebis for her.

videos.title: Khushi Meets a Kid
videos.overview: Khushi informs Arnav about a kid she met at the designer shop. Later, when Khushi visits the vegetable market with Nandkishore, she meets the same kid. When some kidnappers try to abduct him, Khushi tries to save him. Who is the kid?

videos.title: Arnav Meets His College Friend
videos.overview: Arnav comes across his college friend Sheetal and her son, Aarav. When he finds out Aarav is the same kid who Khushi saved from the kidnappers, he rebukes her for risking her life. Will Khushi be able to justify her actions?

videos.title: Sheetal Enters Arnav's Office
videos.overview: Khushi  wonders how similar Aarav and Arnav are. She serves pancakes in bed to Arnav, which he appreciates. Meanwhile, Arnav interviews Sheetal for a job she applied for at his office. Later, Aarav faints in a toy shop. Khushi finds him and takes him to Shantivan.

videos.title: Sheetal Is Arnav’s Ex-Girlfriend
videos.overview: Arnav introduces Sheetal to his family. But when the family members find similarities between Arnav and Aarav, Khushi is dismayed. Will Arnav tell Khushi about Sheetal?

videos.title: Aarav Is Diabetic
videos.overview: Khushi is restless on learning that Sheetal is Arnav’s ex-girlfriend. Later, Sheetal visits Shantivan to collect Aarav’s prescription. The doctor informs Sheetal and Khushi that Aarav is diabetic.

videos.title: Khushi Invites Sheetal
videos.overview: Khushi suspects that Aarav is Arnav's son when the doctor tells her that the boy is diabetic. Khushi even invites Sheetal and Aarav to come and stay with them. What is Khushi trying to achieve?

videos.title: Who Is Aarav’s Father?
videos.overview: Aarav refuses to reveal his father’s name. Khushi tries to find out from his admission form kept in the Principal's office, but  she is unsuccessful. What will Khushi’s next step be?

videos.title: Arnav Finds the DNA Test Report
videos.overview: Khushi manages to stick chewing-gum secretly on Aarav's head to get a fews strands of his hair for DNA testing. But Arnav discovers the DNA test report. How is Arnav going to react?

videos.title: Khushi Tears Up  the DNA Report
videos.overview: Khushi tears up the DNA test report after an offended Arnav gets tells her that he never had an intimate relationship with Sheetal.  Will Khushi find Aarav's father?

videos.title: The Basketball Match
videos.overview: During the basketball match organised by Khushi to please Arnav, Sheetal and Arnav argue over who is better at the sport. While Aarav, Nandkishore and Akash join Arnav’s team, Khushi and Manorama join Sheetal’s.

videos.title: Khushi Questions Sheetal
videos.overview: The bonding between Aarav, Arnav and Sheetal upsets Khushi. Khushi finds Arnav and Sheetal’s college photos in the latter’s room. She asks Sheetal about Aarav’s father. What will Sheetal’s reply be?

videos.title: Aarav's Surprise Meeting
videos.overview: Sheetal promises to arrange a meeting between Aarav and his father. The Raizada family gets curious on seeing Aarav in a good mood and asks him about it. Will Aarav tell them the reason for his happiness?

videos.title: Aarav Goes Missing
videos.overview: Sheetal breaks her promise and sends Aarav to school instead of taking him to the café to meet his father. But Aarav manages to go to the café secretly. The class teacher informs Sheetal of his absence from school. Will Arnav, Khushi and Sheetal be able to find Aarav?

videos.title: Khushi’s First Karva Chauth
videos.overview: It is the first Karva Chauth for Khushi and Payal after marriage. Khushi finds it difficult to fast for the entire day. She finds out that Sheetal is also fasting. But for whom is she celebrating Karva Chauth?

videos.title: The Karva Chauth Celebration
videos.overview: Sheetal is jealous when she sees Arnav and Khushi celebrating Karva Chauth together. Arnav gifts a catering company to Khushi. But what happens later that Khushi breaks down into tears?

videos.title: Aarav Is Related to Arnav
videos.overview: After seeing the DNA report, which states that Aarav is related to Arnav, Khushi questions Sheetal. Sheetal asks her not reveal this to Arnav. Aarav is upset about the father’s day celebration at his school and so Khushi asks Arnav to go to Aarav’s school.

videos.title: Arnav Goes to Aarav’s School
videos.overview: Everybody is stunned when Arnav participates in Aarav’s school event on father’s day. He and Aarav win a music competition together by playing drums. Arnav talks to Khushi about starting their family. What will Khushi's reaction be?

videos.title: Arnav Confronts Sheetal
videos.overview: Arnav denies the claim of Aarav being his son and says he was never intimate with with Sheetal. But she says he was drunk when it happened. She decides to leave his house with Aarav. Khushi tries to stop her. Will Sheetal go away?

videos.title: Aarav, an Orphan?
videos.overview: Aarav tells Arnav about his stay in an orphanage. Meanwhile, Sheetal secretly plans her revenge against Arnav. Will Khushi notice the change in Sheetal's attitude?

videos.title: Arnav Exposes Sheetal
videos.overview: Arnav exposes Sheetal's lie before the Raizada family. She had adopted Aarav and trained him to behave like Arnav. What was her actual intention?

videos.title: Celebration at Shantivan
videos.overview: Khushi and Arnav get into an argument over bursting crackers. Aarav becomes furious at Khushi for not letting him eat sweets before the puja. Arnav makes rangoli along with Khushi. What is the celebration about?

videos.title: Arnav Taunts Khushi
videos.overview: When Arnav gets a bicycle and a cricket bat for Aarav, Khushi asks him not to indulge Aarav with expensive gifts. But Arnav tells her not interfere in money matters. Khushi takes up his taunt as a challenge. How is she going solve the problem?

videos.title: Khushi Aspires to Be a Model
videos.overview: Khushi rejects Arnav’s proposal to work at his office and makes up her mind to participate in the Mrs. India competition. How is her family going to react?

videos.title: Manorama Is Jealous of Khushi
videos.overview: When the Raizada family finds out that Khushi aspires to participate in the Mrs. India contest, Nani teaches her to dance but Manorama feels dismayed. She plans to sabotage Khushi’s preparation for the competition. What will she do?

videos.title: Khushi Goes for the Audition
videos.overview: Arnav plans to make Khushi the head of a fashion designing project in his firm. She rejects it and visits the Glamglitz event company to audition for the Mrs. India contest, but panics on meeting the judges of the show. Is Arnav aware of Khushi’s plan?

videos.title: A Model Humiliates Khushi
videos.overview: When Khushi introduces herself, a famous model, Natasha, interrupts and ridicules her. Khushi returns home dejected. Will Khushi get through to the next round?

videos.title: Arnav Learns About Khushi’s Plan
videos.overview: Arnav joins Riya and Jay as the third judge for the fashion show. Arnav is shocked to see Khushi participating in the contest. How will Khushi react on seeing Arnav as a judge?

videos.title: The Interview on Khushi
videos.overview: While the contestants undergo physical training, Arnav asks Sam to enhance Khushi’s workout. The Raizada family is informed by the contest organisers that the media wants to interview them. Manorama is extremely excited about the interview.  What will they reveal in the interview?

videos.title: Arnav Helps Khushi
videos.overview: Vikrant, the contest organiser, eliminates Khushi, as she refuses to wear a swimsuit. But Arnav intervenes and changes the rules of the contest. Khushi appreciates his assistance and Arnav reminds her of something.

videos.title: Khushi’s Wardrobe Malfunction
videos.overview: Sam selects costumes for the talent round and Amrita plays around with Khushi’s gown. Her dress tears on the stage. How will Khushi cope with this embarrassment?

videos.title: Khushi Shares Her Ideas
videos.overview: Jay allows Khushi  to pair up with a family member instead of Arnav for the husband and wife round. Khushi reveals her strategies for the round to one of her fellow contestants. Whom did she confide in?

videos.title: Khushi Impresses the Judges
videos.overview: Amrita hires a man to pose as her husband for the husband and wife round. But Jay and Riya learn about it and disqualify her from that round. Khushi manages to impress the judges. Whom does she call on stage?

videos.title: Arnav Kisses Khushi
videos.overview: After Khushi wins the husband and wife round, Arnav tells them Khushi is his wife. He announces that he will not judge the final round, to be fair to the other contestants. Amrita is disqualified in the last round for stealing the questions. Who will win the contest?

videos.title: Khushi-Arnav, Three Years Later!
videos.overview: Arnav Singh Raizada wakes up one fine morning and doesn’t find his wife, Khushi by his side. Instead, he finds a very angry message from her. Now, what has ASR done to spite her? Well, he’s forgotten their third wedding anniversary! In between wrapping gifts and planning how to woo her back home, Arnav fondly remembers his first meeting with small town girl, Khushi who slowly made way into his heart and life.

videos.title: Gifts Galore for Khushi-Asr
videos.overview: Arnav is thinking how Khushi has changed his life for the better. He remembers their ‘Money Versus Devi Maiyya’ argument and how she had first made him, Di’s Chhote, smile! While Khushi continues to stay miffed, ASR gets another reprimanding caller and two tickets to Lucknow. But wait, there is a problem!

videos.title: Hello Brother
videos.overview: Arnav’s cousin, Aakash arrives to wish him on his special day. Arnav checks on Aakash’s wife, Payal who is expecting their first child. As the brothers talk about how marriage changes everything, they also remember how Khushi and ASR had brought Payal and Aakash together. Later, Aakash leaves but not before telling Arnav that Khushi wants to discuss an important ‘issue’ with him!

videos.title: Chhote Asks Di for Help
videos.overview: Arnav’s di, Anjali calls him up to wish on his big day. The brother-sister share many memories of ‘Khushiji’. Anjali has sent a sari too for Khushi. She pulls Arnav’s leg as she tries to make him spill some of his and Khushi’s secrets but ASR brushes them aside saying some things are best left secrets, Later, ASR asks his Di for a favour!

videos.title: ASR Still Can’t Say ‘ILU’
videos.overview: ASR decides to raise a toast with bhaang and not champagne because Khushi doesn’t drink it! He’s surprised that Khushi hasn’t come home because he had asked his di to tell her that he wasn’t well. Just as ASR prepares himself to say ‘I love you’ to Khushi, there’s a doorbell. Has Khushi Kumari arrived?

videos.title: Khushi Sends a Spy
videos.overview: The doorbell rings and ASR opens the door only to find his ‘Hello, hi, bye bye’ maamiji! She tells him that she’s come on Khushi’s behalf to spy on him. She has also brought gifts for him and Khushi and just before leaving, makes him hear Khushi’s angry message!

videos.title: Finally, Khushi Aa Gayi!
videos.overview: ASR receives Khushi’s message saying she’s going to Lucknow to meet her parents and buaji. ASR remembers the time he had forgotten Khushi’s birthday and how her buaji had taken him to task. ASR’s patience is running out as he sends sorry messages to Khushi. Just then, he gets a call from her! Is she around him?

videos.title: I Love You, Dammit!
videos.overview: Finally, ASR meets Khushi who hasn’t gone anywhere. ASR apologises to her and she forgives him with a hug. They both then get ready to celebrate their three years of togetherness and bliss as they cut the cake and share warm hugs and tender kisses.

videos.title: Iss Pyaar Ko… Ek Jashn
videos.overview: So you all celebrated the return of Khushi and Arnav Singh Raizada and their third wedding anniversary; now watch the making of this super story of the super Jodi and let the celebrations continue.
